FROM 127.0.0.1:5001/neon/pg17-dev-tools:linux-v1
SHELL ["/bin/bash","-euo","pipefail","-c"]
ENV GOPATH=/go GOMODCACHE=/go/pkg/mod GOCACHE=/root/.cache/go-build GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.1
ENV NEON_V2_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nonroot@127.0.0.1:55439/pg17_control_test?sslmode=disable NEON_V2_TEST_SCHEMA=v2_migration_pg17_placement NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost,::1
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
WORKDIR /workspace/api
ARG VALIDATION_NONCE
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=autoscaling-gomod-amd64,target=/go/pkg/mod,sharing=locked \
 --mount=type=cache,id=controlplane-gobuild-go127-amd64,target=/root/.cache/go-build,sharing=locked \
 printf 'ACTUAL_CP_PLACEMENT_RUN=%s\n' "$VALIDATION_NONCE"; printf %s  | base64 -d > /tmp/control-source-manifest.go; go run /tmp/control-source-manifest.go; go test -mod=readonly -json -race -count=1 -p=2 -timeout=20m ./internal/control -run '^(TestDSGAResourcePublicPolicyRequiresV3PlacementBeforeReservation|TestDSGAVM3SnapshotOwnsPlacementAndHistoricalVersionsStayFrozen|TestDSGAReservationVM3ForwardMigrationPreservesV1V2AndRequiresPlacement)$'
